title: Time Off
description: Represents time-off data for a worker in Workday, including time-off requests, entries, balances, and leave of absence records.

id.description: The Workday ID of the time-off record.

descriptor.description: A display descriptor for the time-off record.

worker.description: The worker this time-off record belongs to.

timeOffType.description: The type of time off (e.g., Vacation, Sick, Personal).

status.description: The status of the time-off request.

totalQuantity.description: The total quantity of time off requested.

unit.description: The unit of measure for time off (e.g., Hours, Days).

comment.description: A comment or reason for the time-off request.

requestedDate.description: When the time-off request was submitted.

balances.description: Time-off plan balances for the worker.

leaveOfAbsence.description: Leave of absence details, if applicable.

href.description: A link to the full time-off resource.

id.description: The Workday ID of the entry.

date.description: The date of the time off.

dailyQuantity.description: The quantity of time off for the day.

unit.description: The unit of measurement (Hours or Days).

timeOffType.description: The time-off type for this entry.

comment.description: A comment for this specific day.

TimeOffBalance.description: A time-off plan balance for a worker.

id.description: The Workday ID of the balance record.

unit.description: The unit of the balance (Hours or Days).

asOfDate.description: The effective date of the balance.

scheduled.description: Total time off scheduled but not yet taken.

leaveType.description: The type of leave (e.g., FMLA, Parental, Medical, Personal).

startDate.description: The start date of the leave.

estimatedEndDate.description: The estimated end date of the leave.

actualEndDate.description: The actual end date of the leave.

lastDayOfWork.description: The last day of work before the leave.

firstDayBackAtWork.description: The first day back at work after the leave.

status.description: The status of the leave of absence.

reason.description: The reason for the leave of absence.

ResourceReference.description: A reference to a Workday resource.

id.description: The Workday ID of the referenced resource.

descriptor.description: A display descriptor for the referenced resource.

href.description: A link to the referenced resource.
